(Ārya)Vimuktasena

But according to others he heard the Abhisamaya from Ācārya Dharmadāsa an. the Upadeśa from Bhavya. He also was the teacher of Bhadanta Vimuktasena.
See E. Conze, Prajñāpāramitā Literature, p.. 112. 122.
Q. in Prajñāpāramitā Condonsorues attributed to Daṃṣṭrāsena, see Acta Or. XI. (1923) 5.
